items.title: Developer CLI launch page
items.headline: A release cockpit for developer CLIs.
items.summary: Package, sign, publish, and document command-line releases from one predictable workflow.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for ForgeCLI, a release cockpit for developer CLI projects. The page should target maintainers who ship binaries, changelogs, install docs, and GitHub releases.
items.proof: A focused workflow for teams that want fewer release scripts and more repeatable shipping.

items.title: Open source docs homepage
items.eyebrow: Documentation that stays close to code
items.headline: Keep open source docs readable as projects grow.
items.summary: DocsRail turns repo structure, examples, and release notes into a clean documentation homepage.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for DocsRail, an open source documentation homepage generator for technical projects.
items.proof: Made for maintainers who need fast orientation, accurate install paths, and docs that do not feel like a wiki dump.

items.title: AI notebook workspace
items.headline: A notebook workspace for AI experiments that need memory.
items.summary: LabSlate keeps prompts, runs, artifacts, and decisions together so research sessions can be resumed.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for LabSlate, an AI notebook workspace for prompt experiments, artifacts, and resumable research sessions.
items.proof: Designed for researchers who need to understand why a result happened, not just save the final output.

items.title: Plugin marketplace page
items.eyebrow: A clean registry for runtime extensions
items.headline: Find, install, and trust plugins without leaving your workflow.
items.summary: PluginDock gives developers a minimal marketplace for skills, MCP servers, and runtime commands.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for PluginDock, a plugin marketplace for developer agents and local runtime extensions.
items.proof: Every plugin page explains capability, permissions, install path, and maintenance status before users add it.

items.title: SaaS analytics product page
items.headline: See the few numbers that actually change roadmap decisions.
items.summary: Northstar Metrics turns event streams into a compact operating view for product leaders.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for Northstar Metrics, a SaaS analytics product that focuses product teams on decision-grade metrics.
items.proof: Built for weekly planning rituals where teams need signal, not another dashboard mosaic.

items.title: API observability launch page
items.eyebrow: API traces that developers can act on
items.headline: Understand broken API calls before customers file tickets.
items.summary: TraceHarbor groups failures by contract, endpoint, and deploy so teams can fix the right thing first.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for TraceHarbor, an API observability tool for debugging contract failures and deploy regressions.
items.proof: The page should feel operational and developer-focused, not like a generic monitoring dashboard.

items.title: Team knowledge base page
items.headline: Turn team decisions into a searchable operating memory.
items.summary: FieldNotes captures decisions, owners, and source links so teams can find the context behind work.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for FieldNotes, a team knowledge base focused on decisions, owners, and searchable operating memory.
items.proof: Useful for teams that lose time reconstructing why work was done and who approved it.

items.title: Design review tool page
items.headline: Catch layout regressions before they reach users.
items.summary: FrameCheck compares responsive screenshots and turns visual review into a repeatable PR workflow.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for FrameCheck, a design review tool for responsive screenshots and visual regression checks.
items.proof: Made for teams that want human visual judgment plus a clean audit trail in pull requests.

items.title: Security changelog page
items.headline: Publish clear patch notes without leaking sensitive details.
items.summary: PatchLedger helps security teams explain fixes, versions, and user actions with controlled disclosure.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for PatchLedger, a security changelog and advisory drafting tool.
items.proof: The page should balance clarity, trust, and operational restraint.

items.title: Customer onboarding page
items.eyebrow: Customer onboarding with fewer loose ends
items.headline: Give every implementation a clear next step.
items.summary: OnboardPath helps customer teams coordinate setup tasks, owners, blockers, and launch readiness.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for OnboardPath, a customer onboarding coordination tool for B2B SaaS teams.
items.proof: The page should feel practical and trustworthy for teams managing many parallel customer launches.

items.title: Local automation tool page
items.headline: Automate desktop routines without handing work to the cloud.
items.summary: DeskPilot runs small local automations for files, forms, exports, and repeatable office tasks.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for DeskPilot, a local-first desktop automation tool for operators.
items.proof: The page should make local control and repeatable workflows feel simple, not technical.

items.title: Developer onboarding docs page
items.headline: Get new engineers from clone to first merged PR.
items.summary: StartHere creates a focused onboarding page from repo setup, architecture notes, and starter issues.
items.prompt: Create a Vue 3 + Vite landing page for StartHere, a developer onboarding docs generator for engineering teams.
items.proof: The page should make setup, context, and first contribution feel concrete.
